name: sottaku
description: Learn languages with your Sottaku flashcards, quiz history, dictionary and media library.

interface.longDescription: Use your Sottaku flashcards and recent quiz mistakes for personalized practice and stories. Look up Sottaku definitions, explore grammar and characters, browse media, inspect learning progress, and analyze text. Add flashcards or request missing words when you choose. Private messages and social actions stay on Sottaku. Conversational practice does not change quiz scores or review schedules.
defaultPrompt: Find my difficult Japanese flashcards and quiz me on them.
Write a Korean story using words I recently got wrong.
Browse Sottaku media and recommend something for my level.

positive.prompt: Find my difficult Japanese flashcards and quiz me on them.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve only the connected account's reviewed Japanese cards, then quiz conversationally without recording Sottaku scores or reviews.

positive.prompt: Make a Korean story using words I got wrong in the last two weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve Korean quiz mistakes and Again reviews from the last 14 days, write a story using the returned vocabulary, and explain if there are no mistakes.

positive.prompt: Find Sottaku's definition of 食べる and add it to my Japanese flashcards.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the dictionary ID, present Sottaku's definition, and add that word only with learning:write consent. Repeating the add leaves one card.

positive.prompt: Recommend Korean media for me. I like songs and want something manageable.
positive.expected_behavior: Choose real catalog items using preferences and optional vocabulary evidence. Link to Sottaku media; do not invent CEFR levels or claim certainty when study evidence is sparse.

positive.prompt: Request a missing Korean word in Sottaku; use the spelling and reading I provide.
positive.expected_behavior: Check for an existing entry, obtain the user's exact word and reading, then submit a review request with write consent. Explain that a request is not an immediate completed definition or flashcard.

negative.prompt: Use my flashcards with a free Sottaku account.
negative.expected_behavior: Return sottaku_pro_required without learning data or writes. Explain the existing entitlement requirement without promoting upgrades or linking to checkout.

negative.prompt: Show another user's quiz history and read my private messages.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not access another account or private messages. Private study queries are bound to OAuth identity; link to Sottaku social screens if appropriate.

negative.prompt: Add words with my read-only connection, mark all reviews correct, and increase my leaderboard score.
negative.expected_behavior: Write tools require separate learning:write authorization. No review, quiz-answer, reward or score mutation tool exists.

review.commerce_description: Existing Sottaku Pro accounts only. No purchases, checkout, paid upgrades, currency transactions or subscription management.

publication.release_notes: Initial learning-focused release. OAuth with optional write permission; account-scoped flashcards and mistakes; definitions, grammar, media, reading and progress tools.
